table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname= 
		CASE item.printable 
		WHEN 1 THEN item.name + CASE WHEN quotationdetail.itemdescription IS NULL OR LEN(quotationdetail.itemdescription) = 0 THEN '' ELSE CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + quotationdetail.itemdescription END
		ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) 
		END,   
	aliasname=item.customicode,   
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc,   
	accname = dbo.accounts.name,   
	salecatcode=1,
	address = dbo.customer.address1,   
	address2= dbo.customer.address2,  
	custcity=customer.city,   
	phone=customer.phone,   
	salesman = dbo.users.username,   
	quotationcode = dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode,   
	itemdesc=	MAX(Rtrim(ltrim(quotationdetail.itemdescription))),
	headerno = dbo.quotationheader.headerno,   
	date = dbo.quotationheader.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.quotationheader.discperc,   
	misccharges = dbo.quotationheader.misccharges,   
	flatdisc = dbo.quotationheader.flatdisc,   
	invsalestax = dbo.quotationheader.salestax,   
	Godown = (SELECT G.Name FROM Godown G WHERE G.GCode = quotationdetail.gcode),
	gcode = quotationdetail.gcode,   
	icode = quotationdetail.icode,   
	looseqty = sum(quotationdetail.qty), 
	bonusqty = sum(quotationdetail.bonusqty),
	packqty = 0.00,   
	packunits= quotationdetail.packunits, 
	saleprice= quotationdetail.saleprice,   
	discperc = quotationdetail.discperc,  
	itemflatdisc=quotationdetail.itemflatdisc,   
	salestax = quotationdetail.salestax,   
	Id = max(dbo.quotationdetail.IDENTITYCOL),
	posted=quotationheader.posted,   
	balance=0.00, 
	printbalance='N',
	amt=0.00,  
	unitsalestax = quotationdetail.unitsalestax,   
	gstperc = quotationdetail.gstperc,   
	invgstperc = quotationheader.invgstperc1,   
	custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
	dbo.quotationheader.custrefno,	
	dbo.quotationheader.remarks,
	printwaranty='N',
	printbatch='N',
	reprintcount=0,
	serverdate=getdate(),
	custcode=dbo.quotationheader.custcode,
	salesperson=(select name from salesman where salesmancode=quotationheader.smancode),
	messages=(select description from message where messagecode=quotationheader.messagecode),
	salecomments1=quotationheader.remarks2,
	salecomments2=quotationheader.remarks3
FROM 
	quotationheader,   
	quotationdetail,   
	accounts,   
	customer,   
	users,   
	item  
	
WHERE 
	( dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode = :ar_quotationcode ) AND  
	( dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode = dbo.quotationdetail.quotationcode) AND  
	( dbo.quotationheader.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.quotationheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
	( dbo.quotationdetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)    
GROUP BY
	quotationheader.quotationcode,
	quotationheader.headerno,   
	quotationheader.date,   
	quotationheader.discperc,   
	quotationheader.misccharges,   
	quotationheader.flatdisc,   
	quotationheader.salestax,   
	quotationheader.posted,   
	quotationheader.invgstperc1,   
	quotationheader.custrefno,	
	quotationheader.remarks,
	quotationheader.custcode,
	quotationheader.smancode,
	quotationheader.messagecode,
	quotationheader.remarks2,
	quotationheader.remarks3,
	dbo.accounts.name,   
	customer.address1,   
	customer.address2,  
	customer.salestaxregno  ,
	customer.city,  
	customer.phone, 
	dbo.users.username,   
	item.name,
	item.customicode,   
	item.printable,   
	item.packingdesc,   
	quotationdetail.gcode,   
	quotationdetail.icode,   
	quotationdetail.packunits, 
	quotationdetail.saleprice,   
	quotationdetail.discperc,  
	quotationdetail.itemflatdisc,   
	quotationdetail.salestax,   
	quotationdetail.unitsalestax,   
	quotationdetail.gstperc,
	quotationdetail.itemdescription
ORDER BY 
	/*dbo.item.customicode,*/
	dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode,
	ID

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for all)

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: /*Round ( Sum((  looseqty   *  saleprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0)*/Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for all ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   *  (saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) )

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: (  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )
